description: This file implements the RemoteTunnelManager actor in Swift, which manages SSH tunnels for remote gateway/control ports. It handles creating, reusing, restarting, and terminating SSH tunnels, including logging and process management.

classes.name: RemoteTunnelManager
classes.description: An actor managing SSH tunnels for remote gateway/control ports, with singleton instance, logging, and restart handling.

methods.name: controlTunnelPortIfRunning
methods.description: Checks if a control tunnel SSH process is active and listening, reuses existing tunnels if possible, or initiates restart.

methods.name: ensureControlTunnel
methods.description: Ensures an SSH tunnel is established for the gateway control port, creating one if necessary.

methods.name: stopAll
methods.description: Terminates all active SSH tunnels managed by this actor.

methods.name: isSshProcess
methods.description: Determines if a process description corresponds to an SSH process.

methods.name: beginRestart
methods.description: Initiates a restart process with backoff to avoid rapid restarts.

methods.name: endRestart
methods.description: Marks the completion of a restart cycle.

methods.name: waitForRestartBackoffIfNeeded
methods.description: Implements delay logic based on the backoff period between restarts.
